verdict.rationale: vLLM ships an OpenAI-compatible API server (and Anthropic/gRPC support) that runs as a standalone HTTP service, which implies it can be exposed to other devices on a network, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents host/port binding or LAN-access configuration for multi-device use. missing for 10: explicit docs on binding to 0.0.0.0/network host, firewall/network setup guidance, and community confirmation of successful cross-device access.
